data.why: qPilot Studio opens with no file uploaded by loading its own cached, SHA-256-pinned demo RDML (the Vermeulen/Ruijter neuroblastoma qPCR benchmark) fetched by `qpilot fetch-demo` during install; no files need to be handed to the browser.

goals: load a plate's raw amplification curves and get curve calls (amplified / not amplified) checked against LinRegPCR
confirm the study design (sample groups, control genes, dilution series) before any result is revealed, so the blind check cannot be swayed by the answer
review AI-proposed Decision Cards and decide, with a reason, only the choices that could flip a gene's up/down conclusion
see how robust a gene's conclusion is across every reasonable combination of analysis choices (the robustness/Decision Simulator audit)
export a Prism-ready bundle (log2 tables per biological unit, a Prism script, provenance) for the confirmed analysis
produce a hash-chained Analysis Record capturing every decision, its reason and who made it, so the analysis can be re-run and verified

review.summary: The tree follows the Studio's staged, blinded workflow faithfully, and its features are mostly well-cut, reusable components. But because the browser crashed and the session was resumed, many design-stage and decision actions cite screens that don't show them, and the Analysis Record and per-well curve review are missing, so it needs fixes before filing.
